## Code Review Findings
### 🟡 Suggestion / Minor
1. CLAUDE.md:146 — the jq test() resolution is stated more absolutely than the semantics strictly warrant. A field inside test() resolves against test()'s input `.`, which is 'the line being tested' only when the line is piped into test() (the common trap the bullet targets); if the accumulator is test()'s direct input, the field resolves against the accumulator. The claim is accurate and the remedy (bind the field to a variable first) is correct in the intended reduce-over-lines context, so this is a clarity nit, not a falsehood — consider scoping the phrasing, e.g. 'when you pipe the line into test(), a bare .field in the argument resolves against that piped line, not the accumulator.' (raised by 1/4 agents)

This is an accurate documentation-only correction: it replaces a false claim ('the lint never reaches the workflow YAMLs that carry inline jq') with a verified account of the two lint surfaces (shellcheck over .sh files; raven-actions/actionlint over workflow run: blocks — both present in ci.yml at HEAD), retains the valid string-op/(.x | strings) guard, and adds a technically-correct reduce/test() trap. All acceptance criteria are satisfied.

Accurate in the intended reduce-over-lines context and the stated fix is correct, so a clarity nit, not a falsehood. Suggest scoping the phrasing.
